gloss: to pinch; to pick up with fingers

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: つまんでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to pinch, to pick up with fingers
definitions.explanation: To grip something small between the thumb and fingers.
To eat small bites of food casually, especially snacks or finger food.

⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つまんで⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I pinched my nose and took the medicine.

notes:
つまむ means to grip something small between the thumb and fingers. It also means to nibble or snack on food casually.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つまむ: to pinch one's nose
- ⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧つまむ: to pick up with chopsticks
- ⟦おつまみ→おつまみ：14928_otsumami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つまむ: to eat snacks/nibbles
- ひとつまみ: a pinch (of salt, etc.)

ASPECT (ている):
つまんで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "is holding/pinching" — the ongoing state of gripping something.

RELATED WORDS:
The noun ⟦おつまみ→おつまみ：14928_otsumami⟧ (snacks to go with drinks) derives from this verb. It literally means "things to pick at."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- つかむ: to grab, to seize (larger grip, whole hand)
- つねる: to pinch (with intent to cause pain, twisting motion)
